hookPublication.activationRule: exact title, text size, executable windows, and managed NOP scaffold before any entry word
hookPublication.lifetimeRule: no executable mutation after startup transaction
hookPublication.journalRule: missing journal retains a zero unpublished snapshot and retries data only

gameplayApply.activation: all immutable hooks publish synchronously before journal load; zero snapshot is retail fallback

experienceShare.runtime: one acquire-loaded packed snapshot; unpublished returns retail true

experienceRate.runtime: one acquire-loaded packed snapshot, unsigned saturating 0-500 percent scaling, and exact retail fallback while unpublished

levelCap.runtime: one acquire-loaded packed snapshot; Off and 100 preserve retail; 1-99 clamp the verified battle and catch award before local and replicated application

gameplayApply.transitionSafety: settings writes commit and verify the journal first, then release-store one packed snapshot; failed commit readback reauthenticates and publishes the durable winner, while an unresolved journal publishes zero retail fallback and rejects further menu I/O until cold launch

optionsMenuAbi.commit: Confirm writes and verifies the journal before stock settings apply. Failure returns to editing and restores stock and KM drafts across controller activation.
optionsMenuAbi.cancel: Discard the view draft; journal stays unchanged.
optionsMenuAbi.slider: Only animation receives the 0 to 10 projection. Numeric labels retain full values.
optionsMenuAbi.legacyPc: No script imports or PC patch. Owned older PC files retire during package upgrade.
optionsMenuAbi.reset: Restore Defaults commits the vanilla journal before the stock defaults are persisted. A failed write preserves the draft.
